script_text: Pisces — Neptune activates your 12th House this week, and the Water element floods your emotions with intensity. Early week, Mars squares your ruling planet Neptune in the 12th House on Monday, creating tension around hidden feelings. Wednesday brings Venus sextile Jupiter in your 7th House, opening a window for love and meaningful partnership. Mid-week turning point: Saturn enters your 10th House on Thursday, shifting career energy as responsibility meets ambition. Late week, the Sun trine Uranus on Saturday sparks unexpected opportunities in finance and creative projects. The weekend carries quiet reflective energy as Neptune deepens your intuitive awareness. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, igniting romantic breakthroughs. Thursday is your worst day because Saturn's square to Neptune creates confusion around professional decisions. Speak your truth in relationships this week before the 10th House transit amplifies pressure. Follow for daily updates.
